description: Header file defining the RuntimeManagerImplementation class, which implements runtime management, configuration, and event handling for a plugin system, including telemetry and container management features.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing runtime management, configuration, event handling, and telemetry features for plugin container management.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Nested class representing a dispatchable job for runtime events, managing reference counting and dispatch logic.
